feed.title: Track Awesome List Updates Weekly
feed.subtitle: We track over 500 awesome list updates, and you can also subscribe to daily or weekly updates via RSS or News Letter.

entry.title: Awesome List Updated on Nov 23 - Nov 29, 2026
entry.content:
1. Awesome Micropython

Display / Graphics

  • RV565 (⭐3) - Native module and C library for playing frame-independent RGB565 video on SPI displays such as the ST7789.

Sensors / Distance Laser

  • erdi-lrf-esp32-micropython (⭐0) - UART driver for ERDI 905 nm / 1535 nm laser rangefinder modules on ESP32, with distance readout and Wi-Fi publish examples.

Frameworks / SRAM

  • FaleraOS (⭐14) - Operating system for an open-hardware ESP32-S3 conference badge, with an app SDK, on-device app store, OTA updates and native video playback.

IDEs / SRAM

  • Micro REPL (⭐165) - MicroPython IDE for Android, desktop and web, with a terminal, a code editor and a visual files explorer.

2. Free for Dev

Email

  • addy.io - Open-source anonymous email forwarding, create unlimited email aliases for free
  • Mailkube - Email infrastructure for developers, 4,000 emails/month free, unlimited domains included
  • turboSMTP - SMTP relay service, free for 200 emails per day or 6000 emails per month, free forever, no time limit, no expiry. Web API, SPF/DKIM authentication, suppression management, 1 sending domain, 2 API keys, 2FA, ticket and chat support, GDPR compliant.

Source Code Repos

  • Upstream - Over 10,000 pushes/sec, the fastest Git host. 100 free repos, public or private, with LFS, merge checks, semantic code search, and AI

APIs, Data, and ML

  • Context.dev - Web scraping API with 1,000 API credits per month (1,000 standard scrapes) plus 10,000 one-time Logo Link requests, no credit card required.
  • CurrencyBeacon - Realtime currency data API for fintech apps. The free plan includes 5,000 calls per month.
  • CustomJS - HTML to PDF or PDF to PNG/Text & PDF merging/extraction/merging APIs. Free tier has 600 calls a month.
  • Kardinal - Route optimization API for delivery and field service fleets: multi-vehicle routing with time windows, vehicle capacities and other real-world constraints, also usable by AI agents. Free tier includes 1,000 stops that never expire, no credit card required.

Tools for Teams and Collaboration

  • Fibery - Connected workspace platform. Free for single users, up to 2 GB disk space.
  • Notion - Notion is a note-taking and collaboration application with markdown support that integrates tasks, wikis, and databases. The company describes the app as an all-in-one workspace for note-taking, project management and task management. In addition to cross-platform apps, it can be accessed via most web browsers.
  • Stoat - An OpenSource alternative forDiscord, that respects your privacy. It also have most proprietary features from discord for free. Stoat is a all in one application that is secure and fast, while being 100% free. every features are free. They also have (official & unofficial) plugins support unlike most main-stream chatting applications.
  • zoom - Secure Video and Web conferencing add-ons available. The free plan is limited to 40 minutes.

Code Generation

  • v0 - Created by Vercel, v0 generates copy-and-paste friendly React code using shadcn/ui and Tailwind CSS. The free plan includes 7 messages per day, Design Mode and GitHub sync.

Code Quality

  • DeepSource - DeepSource continuously analyzes source code changes, finding and fixing issues categorized under security, performance, anti-patterns, bug-risks, documentation, and style. Native integration with GitHub, GitLab, and Bitbucket.
  • proofline.sh - AI code review for GitHub pull requests, with infrastructure-aware checks when connected to a deployment environment. Free forever for open repos, and no subscription required if you BYOK on any private repo.
  • SonarQube Cloud - Automated source code analysis for Java, JavaScript, C/C++, C#, VB.NET, PHP, Objective-C, Swift, Python, Groovy and even more languages, free for Open Source

Security and PKI

  • Chainguard - Hardened, minimal container images and a software supply chain security platform. The Starter plan is free with no credit card: five users, five container images, 50,000 dependency pulls and 100 GB of artifact storage per month.
  • Safety - Software supply chain security for Python, JavaScript and Docker dependencies. The free plan covers one codebase and 100 scans per month for a single user, for non-commercial use.
  • tridentstack.com - Patch, vulnerability and compliance management for Windows, macOS and Linux endpoints. Free forever for up to 200 endpoints with every feature included, no credit card required.

Authentication, Authorization, and User Management

  • Hexclave - Open-source authentication that doesn't suck. The most developer-friendly solution, getting you started in just five minutes. Self-hostable for free, or offers a managed SaaS version with 10k free Monthly Active Users.

Log Management

  • Better Stack Logs - ClickHouse-based SQL-compatible log management. The free plan includes 3 GB of logs retained for three days.

Monitoring

  • Uptimeify - Permament free status pages including custom domain, subscribers (mail, slack, teams, webhook and rss) and maintenance with postmortems. Fully hosted inside the EU.

Education and Career Development

  • Cisco Networking Academy - Offers free certification-aligned courses in topics like cybersecurity, networking, and Python.

Forms

  • FormTango - Form backend for static sites and AI-built apps. Free plan: 100 submissions a month, unlimited forms, spam filtering and email notifications. Endpoints can be created from the API with no account.
  • Kwes.io - Feature rich form endpoint. Works great with static sites. The free plan includes up to 1 website with up to 50 monthly submissions.

Generative AI

  • Respan - LLM observability and gateway with one format for 200+ models. The free plan includes 100,000 logs, 1,000 scores, five datasets, two evaluators and ten prompts per month, with no credit card required.

CDN and Protection

  • ovh - Free DDoS protection and SSL certificate

PaaS

  • Ravion - Deploy web services, databases, and more on your own AWS account with a Git push style workflow. The Individuals plan is free for one user with up to 50 modules, 2,000 pipeline minutes and $20 of AI tokens per month. AWS costs are billed through AWS, but you can use credits and the AWS free tier.

BaaS

  • IFTTT - Automate your favorite apps and devices. Free 2 Applets

Web Hosting

  • readthedocs.com - Free documentation hosting with versioning, PDF generation, and more

Managed Data Services

  • CrateDB - Distributed Open Source SQL database for real-time analytics. Free Tier CRFREE: One-node with 2 CPUs, 2 GiB of memory, 8 GiB of storage. One cluster per organization, no payment method needed.
  • Raff - Managed PostgreSQL, MySQL and Valkey, 1 free database per account with no expiry, 1 vCPU, 1 GB RAM and 2 GB storage (Valkey: 512 MB memory), 20 direct and 200 pooled connections on PostgreSQL, TLS on every database, pauses after 7 days without connections and resumes in about a minute. No egress fees.
  • SeaTable - Flexible, Spreadsheet-like Database built by the Seafile team. unlimited tables, 2,000 lines, 1-month versioning, up to 25 team members.

Storage and Media Processing

  • We.Team - Encrypt, share, copy, and move all your cloud storage files from one place. The basic plan provides unlimited file transfer with 250 MB max. file size and allows five encrypted files
  • QRdx - Free Open-source QR code generator, plus an image API that needs no key (SVG, PNG, WebP or EPS). Free: unlimited static QR codes with no account, the image API up to 300 requests a minute, and 10 dynamic QR codes with scan analytics on a free account.
  • Tigris - S3-compatible object storage with no egress fees. The free tier includes 5 GB of storage, 10,000 write requests and 100,000 read requests per month, with no card required.

Design and UI

  • Canva - Create product mockups, 200 free mockups.
  • Umso - Generate, edit, and publish beautiful websites and landing pages for your startup, all without code. The free plan covers one site with a homepage, blog and free subdomain, with Umso branding.

IDE and Code Editing

  • cocalc.ai - Collaborative calculation in the cloud. Browser access to full Ubuntu with built-in collaboration and lots of free software for mathematics, science, data science, preinstalled: Python, LaTeX, Jupyter Notebooks, SageMath, scikitlearn, etc.
  • Eclipse Che - Web-based and Kubernetes-Native IDE for Developer Teams with multi-language support. Open Source and community-driven. An online instance hosted by Red Hat is available at workspaces.openshift.com.
  • OnlineCompiler.io - Online compiler and code execution API for 46 languages. The editor is free with no sign-in, and the free API plan includes 100,000 runs a month.

Analytics, Events and Statistics

  • Fivetran - Reverse ETL & Operational Analytics Platform. Sync 10 fields from your data warehouse to 60+ SaaS like Salesforce, Zendesk, or Amplitude.
  • Lyssna - Test designs and mockups on real people and track visitors. The free plan includes unlimited quick studies, three seats and 15 self-recruited test or survey responses.
  • Row Zero - Blazingly fast, connected spreadsheet. Connect directly to data databases, S3, and APIs. Import, analyze, graph, and share millions of rows instantly. Three free (forever) workbooks.

Payment and Billing Integration

  • Autumn - Billing infrastructure for SaaS: pricing models, entitlements, usage tracking and checkout. The free plan includes 25,000 in monthly billing volume, 10,000 customers and 10 million API requests.

3. Open Source Flutter Apps

Productivity

  • ManaWG - Self-hostable shared-flat app with expense splitting, a cleaning rota, shopping list, calendar, notice board and chat. (Source (⭐1))

Developer Tools

  • Kaeso - MIT-licensed, self-hosted AI gateway in Rust, with OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible APIs, SSO, budgets and request logs. (Source (⭐6))

4. Awesome Pinned Gists

External Services

  • MapleStory-Pin-Box (⭐1) - Update a pinned gist to show your MapleStory (KMS) character's level, job, combat power, and server.
  • nba-box (⭐1) - Update a pinned gist to contain your favourite NBA team stats, record, and recent game results.
  • steam-recent-games-box (⭐1) - Update a pinned gist to contain your most recently played Steam game.
  • storygraph-box (⭐2) - Update a pinned gist to contain your latest StoryGraph reads, listens and Audible listening time.

5. Awesome Research

Pomodoro / Enterprise Git Service

  • Yellow Tomato (Chrome,iOS): Pomodoro timer that blocks distracting sites and apps only during focus sessions, with a task list and focus stats [Free].

Writing / Social Sciences

  • research-kit (⭐0): Open command-line tools that check a paper before submission (references, numbers, anonymity, page limits), with a map of the best open projects for each stage of research.

Investigate Papers / HTML+CSS+JS

  • Lacuna: Search 2.3 million ML and AI papers, the researchers behind them, and the research directions they form; free, no account, with a read-only MCP server (⭐70) for AI assistants.

Open Science / HTML+CSS+JS

  • AutoResearch: Browser-based AI research system that connects literature exploration, research ideas, model implementation, GPU experiments and manuscript drafting. Private beta: apply on the site, wait for administrator approval, then set a password from the follow-up email and sign in; approved members receive 5,000 starter credits. Official pages say access is free during the beta, but this is a limited allowance, not unlimited use and not access without an account. Prices for future plans are not yet announced.

6. Awesome Algorithms

Cheat Sheet / YouTube Playlist

  • Rice university DS course in short

7. Awesome Theoretical Computer Science

Big Lists / Monograph

  • Error Correction Zoo - Catalog of classical and quantum error-correcting codes, organized by their relations, with references.

8. Awesome Open Source Games

Browser-Based / Arcade

  • XPilot TNG (⭐0) - Modernized SDL3 fork of the classic 90s multiplayer space combat game XPilot, featuring improved graphics, smartbots, and voice chat.

9. Awesome Talks

Cognitive Development

  • Grokking the Brain: What AI Reveals About How You Really Learn by Barbara Oakly (GOTO Copenhagen 2026) [49:55]

10. Awesome Computational Biology

Drug Response & Perturbation

  • scCT-DB — Cancer treatment single-cell database with 266 paired pre/post-treatment datasets, 6.19M cells, 1,142 samples, 27 cancer types, and 102 drugs.
  • scICB — Pan-cancer ICB therapy single-cell database spanning 338 patients, 807 samples, 3.69M cells, and 13 cancer types, including 247 matched pre/post-treatment patients.
  • CellResDB — Cancer therapy response single-cell database containing 4.7M cells from 1,391 patient samples, 72 datasets, and 24 cancer types.
  • Gondal et al. 2025 ICB scRNA-seq collection — Integrated ICB-treated cancer single-cell collection from eight studies and 223 patients, with 90,270 cancer cells and 265,671 other cells.

Genetic Perturbation & Perturb-seq

  • scPerturbBench (TianGzlab / PerturbArena) (⭐11) — Benchmark of single-cell genetic perturbation prediction covering unseen perturbations, combinations, cell-state transfer, and 24 evaluation metrics.
  • scPerturBench (BM2 Lab) (⭐110) — Benchmark comparing 27 single-cell perturbation-response prediction methods across 29 genetic and chemical perturbation datasets.

General Biological ML & Knowledge Graph Benchmarks

  • CellBench (CellVoyager) (⭐273) — Benchmark for evaluating LLMs and data-analysis agents on reproducible single-cell research tasks.

Preprocessing Tools

  • SpatialData — Interoperable data structures and tooling for spatial omics, microscopy images, coordinates, segmentation shapes, and annotations.

Bioinformatics & Omics Agents

  • CellVoyager (⭐273) — Jupyter-based scientific agent that plans, executes, and evaluates single-cell transcriptomics analyses, accompanied by CellBench.

Single-cell Foundation Models / Transcriptomics Foundation Models

  • Cell2Sentence / C2S-Scale (⭐896) — Single-cell language-model family representing gene-expression profiles as cell sentences for cellular interpretation, generation, and question answering.

Multi-Modal Foundation Models / Protein Structure Prediction and Design

  • TxGemma — Open Gemma-based therapeutic-development model family (2B, 9B, and 27B) for property prediction and interactive scientific reasoning.
  • NVIDIA Nemotron for Science — Scientific-agent development stack based on Nemotron 3.5 Super VL, with post-training recipes and chemistry reasoning benchmark LitmusBench v0.2.

11. Awesome Appimage

AppImage developer tools / Deployment tools for compiled applications

  • AppImage Packaging (⭐1) - Skills for Claude and other coding agents (Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, ...) that package Linux applications as self-contained AppImages, build and publish them from GitHub Actions, and verify and troubleshoot them on other distributions.

12. Awesome Playcanvas

3D Gaussian Splatting / YouTube Playables

  • KosmoWorld - Explore and share 3D scenes captured with Hesai's Kosmo.

13. Awesome Qubes OS

Customization

  • Multiload-Qubes (⭐3) - Qubes OS XFCE panel plugin: system monitor with scrolling charts for CPU, RAM, swap, network, and disk i/o

14. awsm.fish

Plugins

  • Web Search (⭐23) - A plugin to search the web from Fish. Inspired by oh-my-zsh/web-search

15. Awesome Transit

GTFS Realtime Libraries & Demo Apps / Rust

  • gtfs-realtime-php (⭐0) - PHP bindings generated from the official GTFS-realtime protocol buffer specification (⭐1.1k), kept current with the spec and on a supported google/protobuf runtime. Available on Packagist as a drop-in replacement for lowa/gtfs-realtime-php.

16. Awesome R Learning Resources

Blogs / Uncategorized

  • Tidy Ecology - Free R tutorials for ecologists, from diversity indices and ordination to occupancy, capture-recapture and population models, each with runnable code and a downloadable R script.

17. Awesome Zig

Fundamentals / Text Editors

  • jinzhongjia/zig-analyzer (⭐4) - A language server (LSP) for Zig, built on an incremental query engine. AI-generated.

Language Essentials / File Format Processing

  • h0rv/jsonschema.zig (⭐2) - JSON Schema Draft 2020-12 validation and schema generation from Zig types. AI-assisted.

Network & Web / Network

  • ANODs/blackwall (⭐1) - VPN client for macOS, Windows, Linux and Android with its own TCP/IP stack, TLS 1.3, REALITY, VLESS, Trojan, VMess and Shadowsocks, and a route per application. AI-generated.

Network & Web / Web Framework

  • h0rv/zchema (⭐4) - Typed JSON APIs with validation and OpenAPI 3.1 generation, built on std.http.Server. AI-assisted.
  • deatil/zig-vin (⭐1) - A template render library like jinja2 for zig. AI-assisted.

Data & Science / Large Language Model

  • h0rv/instructor.zig (⭐2) - Structured LLM output with validation and retries for OpenAI and Anthropic. AI-assisted.
  • h0rv/openai.zig (⭐1) - Generated SDK for the OpenAI API. AI-assisted.
  • h0rv/anthropic.zig (⭐0) - Generated SDK for the Anthropic API. AI-assisted.
  • h0rv/openresponses.zig (⭐0) - Generated SDK for the Open Responses API specification. AI-assisted.

Data & Science / Encryption

  • Defense-Exploration-Holdings/crypto-api-ng (⭐0) - Zero-dependency hashing library (MD/SHA/SHA-3/BLAKE/RIPEMD/Whirlpool/Streebog/SM3, HMAC, PBKDF2, HKDF) in Zig, shipped to npm as WebAssembly. AI-generated.

Multimedia & Graphics / GUI

  • JonathanRiche/verde (⭐35) - Native multi-agent coding desktop workspace. Use with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Grok and OpenCode. AI-generated.

18. Awesome Amazon Seller

Product Research and Pre-Launch

  • okdata - REST API and MCP server for Amazon product search, details, reviews and Best Sellers in 22 Amazon stores, plus 1688, Taobao and AliExpress listings, suppliers and buyer reviews. Pay per call. GitHub (⭐0)

19. Awesome Agriculture

Automation and Robotics

  • Sowbot (⭐104) - Open-hardware seeding and weeding robot for smallholder agroecological farms, with a ROS 2 stack.

Climate, Environment and Weather

  • MAgPIE (⭐145) - Global land-use allocation model linking agricultural production, land use and environmental impacts.
  • SoilHive Core (⭐9) - Federated platform for discovering, harmonising and sharing soil datasets across institutions.

Crop Modeling, Phenotyping, and Pathology

  • apsimNGpy (⭐37) - Python interface for running and analysing APSIM Next Generation simulations.
  • Contour Alley Designer (⭐0) - Field-scale agroforestry design model (contour alley cropping, shelterbelts, silvopasture) that simulates 40 years on real terrain and soils. Research software in development.
  • CroptimizR (⭐32) - R package for parameter estimation and uncertainty analysis of crop models.
  • DSSAT (⭐240) - Decision Support System for Agrotechnology Transfer cropping system model.
  • Epicrop.jl - Crop disease epidemic simulation using a compartmental (HLIP) model, in Julia.
  • FielDHub (⭐60) - R/Shiny app for designing agricultural field experiments.
  • Phenomenal (⭐45) - 3D plant phenotyping and organ segmentation from multi-view images.
  • PlantGL (⭐81) - Geometric library for modelling and visualising plant architecture.

Regional Data / Nepal

  • Nepal Open Farm Data (⭐0) - District figures for coffee, tea, large cardamom, apple, plum and related crops from the Nepal agriculture ministry (MoALD) statistical yearbooks, as CC BY 4.0 CSV.

Data Standardization, Interoperability and APIs / United States

  • FoodOn (⭐249) - Open ontology for food, food sources and food processing.

Farm Management Systems and Record Keeping / United States

  • AnimalTrakker - Mobile record keeping for sheep and goat flocks.
  • DigiAgriApp - Field and orchard data management server with sensor and remote-sensing integration.

IoT, Hardware / United States

  • Mycodo (⭐3.3k) - Environmental monitoring and regulation for mushrooms, hydroponics and greenhouses.
  • OpenSprinkler (⭐569) - Firmware for the open irrigation controller.
  • Smart Irrigation (⭐572) - Home Assistant integration that schedules irrigation from evapotranspiration.

Markets and Food Systems / United States

  • FoodCoopShop (⭐124) - Ordering and stock software for food co-ops and local farm shops.
  • foodsharing - Platform behind foodsharing.de, coordinating volunteers who rescue surplus food.
  • Foodsoft (⭐360) - Ordering, accounting and member management for non-profit food co-ops.
  • Juntagrico (⭐55) - Management platform for community-supported agriculture: memberships, shares, deliveries and work shifts.
  • Karrot - Organising tool for grassroots groups that save and share food.
  • Open Food Network (⭐1.3k) - Online marketplace for farmers and food hubs to sell directly to eaters.
  • OpenOlitor (⭐20) - Administration software for community-supported agriculture initiatives.
  • Teikei (⭐66) - Map platform connecting consumers with community-supported agriculture (CSA) farms.

Remote Sensing and Imagery / United States

  • OpenDroneMap (⭐6.6k) - Drone image processing into orthomosaics, elevation models and plant health maps.
  • sentinel-crop-pipeline (⭐5) - Reproducible Sentinel-2 L2A data preparation for crop-classification models: scene discovery, cloud masking, patches, spatially blocked splits and label masks, with an optional Gemini or Claude scene filter.
  • WebODM (⭐4.3k) - Web interface for processing and sharing OpenDroneMap drone surveys.

20. Awesome Rtc

Server Software / General Purpose

  • FreeSWITCH (⭐5.3k) - Open source communications server for voice, video, messaging and conferencing.
  • Asterisk - PBX framework supporting multiple protocols and platforms.

Server Software / SIP Servers

  • Kamailio - Open source SIP server for routing, registration, presence and large-scale deployments.
  • OpenSIPS - Open source SIP proxy and application server for VoIP platforms.
  • FreeSBC (⭐369) - Open source SIP/WebRTC edge proxy with an embedded RTP relay for FreeSWITCH and Asterisk.
  • P-KISS-SBC (⭐114) - Kamailio and rtpengine-based session border controller for connecting SIP trunks and PBXs.

Server Software / Media Servers

  • LiveKit (⭐22k) - Open source WebRTC server and SDK ecosystem for real-time audio, video and data.
  • rtpengine (⭐1k) - RTP and UDP based media traffic proxy, usable as a kernel module.
  • MediaMTX (⭐21k) - Media server and proxy bridging WebRTC, RTSP, RTMP and SRT streams, with recording and playback.
  • go2rtc (⭐15k) - Camera streaming gateway with WebRTC viewing, RTSP restreaming and two-way audio integrations.

Server Software / STUN/TURN

  • STUNner (⭐1.1k) - Kubernetes-native STUN/TURN gateway for WebRTC media.

Clients / STUN/TURN

  • Web SIP Phone (⭐8) - Chrome extension maintaining SIP/WebRTC audio for server-controlled call center agents.
  • baresip (⭐2.3k) - Modular SIP user agent with command-line controls, audio/video calls and pluggable media modules.

Operations / Monitoring

  • sip-exporter (⭐58) - Open-source eBPF sensor exporting Prometheus metrics and Grafana dashboards for host-observed IPv4/UDP SIP and correlated RTP/RTCP.
  • rtcStats (⭐47) - WebRTC API trace and getStats collection, storage and feature extraction tooling.
  • SIP3 Community Edition - Open source SIP/RTP capture, analysis and monitoring components with community deployment tooling.

Operations / Testing

  • SIPp (⭐1.2k) - Traffic generator and scenario-based test tool for the SIP protocol.

Operations / Web/API Interfaces

  • Kazoo (⭐992) - Legacy open source VoIP API platform built on FreeSWITCH and Kamailio, available in the public 4.3 branch.
  • AI Native Call Center (⭐659) - FreeSWITCH-based call center with speech-to-speech AI, agent queues and a web interface/API.

Operations / Billing

  • CGRateS (⭐528) - Open source rating, charging and billing engine for telecom and ISP services.

Developer Resources / Tutorials

  • WebRTC.org - Official WebRTC guides, APIs and project resources.
  • Getting Started With WebRTC - Official introduction to media capture and peer-to-peer connectivity APIs.
  • WebRTC for the Curious - Open book explaining WebRTC protocols, architecture and practical debugging.

Developer Resources / JavaScript Libraries

  • JsSIP - Open source JavaScript SIP library with WebRTC media support.
  • Peerix (⭐7) - TypeScript WebRTC library for peer-to-peer media and data with pluggable signalling drivers.
  • werift (⭐649) - TypeScript WebRTC implementation for Node.js with media, data channels and RTP/RTCP APIs.
  • Longpipe - Real-time video effects for WebRTC streams in the browser: virtual background, background blur, face touch-up and auto-reframe.

Developer Resources / C/C++ Libraries

  • libre (⭐195) - Portable SIP, SDP, RTP, SRTP and ICE/STUN/TURN library with asynchronous I/O.
  • icey (⭐1.4k) - C++20 media toolkit combining WebRTC, FFmpeg, asynchronous networking and signalling.
  • GStreamer WebRTC - WebRTC elements for connecting native GStreamer media pipelines to browser peers.

Developer Resources / Rust Libraries

  • WebRTC.rs (⭐5.2k) - Asynchronous WebRTC implementation in Rust with SDP, RTP, RTCP and SRTP support.

Developer Resources / Dart Libraries

  • dart-sip-ua (⭐374) - Dart SIP user-agent stack with SIP over WebSocket and WebRTC media support.
  • Flutter WebRTC (⭐4.5k) - WebRTC bindings for Flutter applications on mobile, desktop and the web.

Developer Resources / Media over QUIC

  • moq-rs (⭐186) - Rust implementation of Media over QUIC Transport with a relay and sample publishers.
  • moq (⭐1.6k) - Rust and TypeScript libraries, relay and browser player implementing moq-lite.
  • moqtail (⭐114) - Rust and TypeScript Media over QUIC Transport libraries with a relay and example clients.
  • moxygen (⭐127) - C++ Media over QUIC Transport library with a relay, sample applications and interoperability tools.
  • libquicr (⭐21) - C++ Media over QUIC Transport library with publish, subscribe, capture and replay tools.
  • imquic (⭐82) - Experimental C library for QUIC and WebTransport with RTP over QUIC and Media over QUIC Transport support.

Blogs / Media over QUIC

  • WebRTC For Developers - Articles, examples and tools for WebRTC application developers.

Discussion / Media over QUIC

  • FreeSWITCH Community - Discord community for FreeSWITCH and SignalWire users and developers.
  • discuss-webrtc - Developer discussion group for WebRTC APIs, implementations and interoperability.

Events and Talks / Media over QUIC

  • ClueCon - Conference for communications and voice AI developers.
  • Kamailio World - Conference announcements and technical sessions covering Kamailio and open source RTC systems.
  • AstriCon - Conference for Asterisk and FreePBX developers and users.
  • CommCon - RTC and open-media community events with a technical talk archive.
  • OpenSIPS Summit - OpenSIPS community conferences with technical presentations and proceedings.
  • JanusCon - Conference proceedings and technical talks for Janus and WebRTC developers.
  • TADHack - Telecom application hackathons, demos and event announcements.

Related Lists / Media over QUIC

  • Awesome Asterisk (⭐13) - Asterisk tooling: ARI, AMI and AGI libraries, call audio streaming, voice AI and testing.
  • Awesome FreeSWITCH (⭐4) - FreeSWITCH tooling: Event Socket libraries, call audio streaming, distributions and monitoring.

21. Android Security Awesome

Tools / Static Analysis Tools

  • LLMObfuscDetection (⭐23) - An open-source framework for detecting and classifying Android code obfuscation techniques using Large Language Models.
  • REA (⭐469k) - Local CLI and MCP server for inspecting APK manifests, decompiled methods, and references with headless JADX.

Tools / Dynamic Analysis Tools

  • TeleGapper (⭐19) - An open-source black-box dynamic analysis framework for analyzing Telegram Mini Apps on Android, capturing network traffic, and checking data-flow disclosures against privacy policies.

Tools / App Repackaging Detectors

  • Detect-Any (⭐1) - open-source Android environment integrity detection: root/Zygisk/hook/Frida/emulator/cloud-phone detection with 142 evidence-graded checks, hardware attestation, and a hot-updatable signature DB.

22. Awesome Composer

Packagist-compatible repositories / IRC

  • Buddy - Composer registry for private PHP packages in the Buddy.Works cloud. Packages are published from a pipeline with the Composer Publish action or with bdy artifact composer publish, and installed with composer install and an access token.

23. Awesome Deno

Modules / CLI utils

  • clinfer (⭐10) - Automatically generate CLIs from JS objects, classes or ES modules.

Modules / Cloud APIs

  • aws-api - From-scratch Typescript AWS API client built for Deno.

Modules / Database

  • kvdock (⭐4) - Zero-dependency key-value and multi-tier caching engine with native Deno KV support and single-flight stampede protection.
  • nessie (⭐519) - Create, migrate and rollback migrations for PostgreSQL, MySQL and SQLite.

Modules / Frontend framework

  • fresh (⭐14k) - The next-gen web framework.

Modules / Image

  • aigifmaker (⭐0) - Turn text prompts into animated GIFs with the AI GIF Maker API.
  • ImageScript (⭐685) - Image processing in JavaScript, utilizing WebAssembly for performance.

Modules / Social Platform APIs

  • Circe (⭐1) - Inversion-of-control framework for discord.js bots with file-system routing, guards and Gateway or HTTP transport.

Modules / Testing

  • tepi (⭐6) - A .http Test Runner

Modules / Utils

  • injecute (⭐5) - Type-safe dependency injection container with explicit wiring and no decorators.

Reports binary hardening flags, dependencies, and release exposure such as shipped source maps, with supporting evidence. The release audit can fail a build at a chosen severity.

Other / Other

  • glsec — Static analysis for GitLab CI/CD pipeline files (.gitlab-ci.yml), detecting insecure patterns such as unpinned includes, components and images, leaked secrets, injection through pipeline inputs and job scripts, unsafe deployments, and supply-chain risks. Runs as a CLI, pre-commit hook, CI step, or GitLab CI/CD component.
  • GuardLink — Continuous threat modeling as code. Security annotations in source comments (threats, exposures, mitigations, flows) form a threat model that updates with the code and is validated and diffed against the base branch in CI. Without an LLM, it reports untrusted-entry-to-sink paths with no control, citing file:line, and tracks which claims are verified or stale. Open exposures become test templates to prove them. Any comment syntax; coding agents maintain it via MCP. Optional LLM threat reports.
  • djLint — Linter and formatter for HTML templates. It understands the template syntax together with the markup and has profiles for Django, Jinja, Twig, Nunjucks, Handlebars, Mustache, Liquid, Go templates, Angular, Tera, Askama and Mako. The linter reports accessibility, correctness and style problems. Runs as a CLI, a language server (LSP), a pre-commit hook and a VS Code extension.

More collections / Other

  • Dev Quality Gates (⭐391) — An opinionated list of quality gates for a dozen languages, CI, infrastructure and git workflows, with one recommended tool per job and its limits

59. Magictools

Graphics / Assets/Placeholders

  • 🆓 CC0 Materials - Free CC0 PBR textures for game environments, up to 4K with OpenGL and DirectX normal maps for Unity, Unreal and Godot.
  • 💸 Gridwright - Pixel-art game asset packs on one grid (tilesets, characters, UI, icons, effects, isometric, music and SFX) for any engine, many with Godot scenes and Tiled tilesets. Each pack has a free sample.
  • 🆓 Iconito Game Food Icons - Food icons for cooking, farming and cozy games, free under the MIT license as SVG, in Figma and on Iconify.
  • 🆓 SceneCrate Free 3D Game Assets - Nine walkable CC0 1.0 3D browser-game scenes (buildings, heightfield terrain, and static props) in two measured GLB tiers, with JSON colliders and offline Three.js examples; no account required.
  • 🆓 Verdant 00 Free Tileset Sampler - 878 top down 16x16 pixel art tiles, including 16 complete 47 mask autotile sets, with importers for RPG Maker MZ, Tiled and Godot; royalty free for commercial use, no credit required. Drawn by a procedural pixel engine written with an AI assistant, no image generators.

Graphics / Spritesheet Tools

  • 🆓 GIF to Sprite Sheet - Browser tool that turns a GIF, animated WebP or video into a PNG sprite sheet, with JSON atlas, Godot .tres and Sparrow XML export. Also cuts sheets into frames and plays a sheet back as a GIF. Files stay on your device.
  • 💰 Gridwright - Pixel-art asset packs drawn on one grid, plus 35 browser tools for tilesets, autotiles, maps, sprite sheets, palettes, effects and sound, with Godot-ready exports.
  • 🆓 MakerGIF Sprite Sheet Converter - Free browser-based GIF and short-video to PNG sprite sheet converter with live WASD animation playtesting, Phaser 3 JSON, and Sparrow v2 XML export; files stay on your device with no account required.
  • 💸 Puff - Preview pixel-art explosions and spell hits in the browser. The paid offline tool exports PNG sprite sheets, Godot 4 SpriteFrames and RPG Maker MV/MZ animations.
  • 🆓 Sprite Sheet Slicer - Slice a sprite sheet by grid or cell size, preview the animation, and export PNG frames plus a Godot- and Unity-friendly JSON atlas.
  • 🆓 SpritePacker - Free browser sprite sheet packer with Compact (MaxRects), Grid, Horizontal and Vertical layouts, padding, extrude and trim. Exports PNG sheets with JSON Hash (Phaser, PixiJS), TexturePacker Generic XML or CSS/SCSS, or as an animated GIF. Frames are packed on your device; no account needed.
  • 🆓 Voidless Sprite Sheet Tools - Free browser sprite sheet cutter/slicer and packer: cut a sheet into frames, or pack sprites into one atlas with PNG and Phaser/PixiJS JSON output. No account needed; files stay in the browser.

Graphics / Vector/Image Editor

  • 🎉 Pixelorama - Free & open source pixel art editor with animation support, made with Godot.

Graphics / Modeling

  • 💸 Trify3D - Browser-based AI 3D generator that runs Tripo3D, Meshy and Rodin side by side and exports game-ready GLB and OBJ assets.

Graphics / Voxel Editors

  • 🆓 Voidless Voxel Editor - Browser voxel editor with box, line and mirror tools. Exports MagicaVoxel .vox, GLB, OBJ and PNG, and renders 8-direction pixel art sprites. No account needed.

AI / Voxel Editors

  • 💸 3DLoom - Image or text to textured 3D game assets, exported as GLB, FBX, OBJ or USDZ, with a low-poly mode for props. 20 free credits on sign-up and no subscription; the GLB, OBJ and FBX converters are free and need no account.
  • 💸 Claude Game Studio - Claude Code plugin for making browser games: 10 tested genre starters, 123 models, 43 materials, 13 skies, and skills to design, build, playtest and fix. The kit is $29 a year; the pixel art maker, game idea generator and design document template on the site are free.
  • 💸 Gridize - AI pixel art sprite and animation generator: make sprites from a prompt or upload your own, animate idle, attack, spell and turnaround clips of 9 to 49 frames on one consistent pixel grid, and export GIF, WebP, PNG frames or sprite sheets with timing JSON. Free credits on signup.
  • 🆓 Markan - Steam market research for indie games: Google Sheets and Excel add-ins that pull Steam data and estimate sales, free pages for about 80,000 games and 420 tags, and a free MCP server so AI assistants can find similar games and estimate their sales. No account needed.
  • 💸 Voidless - AI game assets: pixel art sprites from 32 to 384 px, sprite animation, 8-direction sprites, tilesets, 3D models, sound and music. Includes an MCP server so Claude Code or Cursor can generate art straight into a project. 60 free credits on sign-up, no subscription.

Collections / Voxel Editors

  • 🆓 8-Bit Arcade SFX Free Lite - 24 free 8-bit sound effects (UI, coins, jumps, lasers, jingles) synthesized by code; free for commercial use, no attribution required.
  • 💸 CSAF Sound Library - 13,315 royalty free game sound effects in 91 packs, WAV and OGG, with a free demo download. Every sound is synthesized in code with no samples or generative audio model; the code was written with AI tools.
  • 💰 Fantasy RPG SFX Bundle - 763 royalty-free combat, magic and loot/UI sounds in WAV and OGG. Combat is edited from CC0 Freesound recordings (mostly real Foley; some designed-sound sources and light synth layers); magic and loot/UI are synthesized in code; AI helped with tooling and text.
  • 🆓 Overture Free Game Music Sampler - 68 game music tracks from 34 albums (fantasy, retro, horror, science fiction, cozy) as OGG, 67 of them with loop points in the file, plus the MIDI source of every track; royalty free for commercial use, no credit required. Composed by code written with an AI assistant, no AI audio models.

Music and Audio Editors / Voxel Editors

  • 🆓 Game SFX Loudness Normalizer & Preview - Measure peak, RMS and BS.1770 loudness of game SFX, preview a normalize, and download a WAV, all in your browser.
  • 🆓 Voidless 8-Bit Sound Generator - sfxr-style retro sound effect generator that runs in the browser. No account needed.

Game Jams / Voxel Editors

  • Fright Queue Horror Jam Tracker - Nightly-updated tracker of horror game jams on itch.io

Project Management / Voxel Editors

  • 🆓 Fright Queue Dev Planner - Steam sale and festival calendar for indie devs, with 30-day discount cooldown windows to plan launches and discounts

60. Awesome Rust

Applications

  • lthoangg/openagentd (⭐216) - A local coding agent as a desktop app (Tauri) and CLI with a native Rust backend; shows every tool call, diff and shell command, and works with your own model keys or local models
  • vey-proxy (⭐51) - Modular async Rust proxy daemon unifying HTTP/SOCKS forward proxying, HTTP/TLS reverse proxying, TPROXY/SNI transparent proxying, TCP/UDP/TLS stream proxying, dynamic egress routing, TLS/ICAP inspection, and hot reloads.
  • VinceGHER/openwren (⭐94) - Privacy-first desktop mail client for Gmail and IMAP that keeps mail encrypted on your computer, built with Tauri

Applications / Audio and Music

  • openwave-studio/opendj (⭐221) - Fast, modern DJ and mixing app for macOS, Windows and Linux, with MIDI/HID controller support, stems, key lock, plugin hosting (CLAP/VST3/AU) and library import from rekordbox, VirtualDJ and djay Pro

Applications / Emulators

  • Gameboy
    • dquigles/terminal_gameboy (⭐82) [terminal_gameboy] - Game Boy and Game Boy Color emulator that runs in the terminal, with ASCII and Unicode block rendering and sound
    • Gekkio/mooneye-gb (⭐972) - A Game Boy research project and emulator
    • joamag/boytacean (⭐683) - GameBoy Color emulator that runs on the Web using WebAssembly.
    • mohanson/gameboy (⭐1.4k) - Full featured Cross-platform GameBoy emulator. Forever boys!.
    • mvdnes/rboy (⭐667) - A Gameboy Emulator

Applications / File manager

  • Koimsurai/Arke (⭐232) - A file explorer for Windows that never freezes, GPU-rendered with GPUI

Applications / Productivity

  • stevyhacker/LokalBot (⭐119) - Private local-first meeting notes (no bot), dictation, inline autocomplete, screen recall, and read-only MCP server with a native Rust + GPUI desktop app for Linux and Windows.

Applications / Social networks

  • XMPP
    • lonewolf-im/lonewolf (⭐109) - A standalone XMPP server

Applications / Utilities

  • Multron-Community/Multron-Download-Manager (⭐25) - Cross-platform download manager built with Tauri that splits files into parallel connections, with browser integration, yt-dlp, FFmpeg, and BitTorrent support.
  • PaperPilot (⭐786) - Privacy-first, local document toolkit, WebAssembly engine, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) server written in pure Rust.

Applications / Virtualization

  • libracoder/kiri (⭐11k) - A small, fast container runtime for macOS, Windows and Linux that runs Docker images in a tiny Linux VM and speaks the Docker Engine API

Development tools / Workflow Automation

  • HyunSeob/iphone-cli (⭐109) [iphone-cli] - Single-binary CLI and MCP server letting AI agents read and operate apps on a real iPhone (iOS 27+) via the accessibility tree without Xcode or WebDriverAgent.
  • mokevnin/heavy (⭐55) [heavy] - A machine-wide counting semaphore for heavy commands: tests, type checks and builds started by parallel coding agents and checkouts take turns instead of starving the machine

Development tools / Static analysis

  • mokevnin/easement (⭐57) [easement] - Architecture quality gate for polyglot codebases: declare components and their allowed dependencies, and fail the build when Go, TypeScript, Python, Rust, Java or other code drifts from them

Development tools / Transpiling

  • erkamyaman/rust-anything (⭐5.2k) [rust-anything] - Ports TypeScript, Python, C, Go, Ruby and Java apps to Rust piece by piece, checking each piece against the recorded behavior of the original.

Libraries / Audio and Music

  • gradium-ai/xn-ptts (⭐509) [ptts] - Streaming inference for Phonon text-to-speech models on CPU, GPU, mobile devices, and browsers

Libraries / Configuration

  • hyperi-io/scalo-rs (⭐0) [scalo] - Runtime for Rust services. It has layered config, redacted structured logs and health probes. It supports Prometheus and OpenTelemetry metrics. Its transports are Kafka, gRPC and HTTP.

Libraries / Data visualization

  • dataviz-rs/dataviz (⭐10) [dataviz] - Fast plotting library with 120+ chart types (statistics, finance, genomics, maps, 3D), interactive windows, PNG/SVG/PDF/HTML output, and Python, JavaScript and C/C++ bindings.

Libraries / Home automation

  • mihai-dinculescu/tapo (⭐877) [tapo] - Client for TP-Link Tapo smart devices (plugs, lights, hubs, sensors and cameras), with Python bindings and an MCP server

61. Awesome Polars

Polars plugins / Import / Export

  • adbc-driver-orkidea (⭐1) - ADBC driver for Oracle Database, written in Rust, that reads query results as Arrow, for pl.read_database or cursor.fetch_polars(), with no Oracle Instant Client needed, by @Tnsor-Labs.
  • polars-yahoo (⭐3) - Minimal Yahoo Finance price history as Polars DataFrames by @Jebel-Quant.

Polars plugins / Data Manipulation

  • polars-bigquery-client (⭐15) - BigQuery client for Polars by @pola-rs.

Polars plugins / Finance

  • fin-primitives (⭐16) - Trading indicators from a Rust core with a pl.col(...).fp expression namespace (SMA, EMA, RSI, MACD, works per group with .over()) and a df.fp DataFrame namespace (ATR, MACD, Bollinger Bands) by @Mattbusel.

entry.title: Awesome List Updated on Nov 16 - Nov 22, 2026
entry.content:
1. Awesome Developer First

Authentication & Identity

  • Frontegg - Customer identity for B2B SaaS: authentication, SSO/SCIM, MFA, RBAC and a self-service admin portal for your customers.

2. Awesome Smart Tv

Other Lists / Official resources

  • awesome-webos (⭐228) - A curated list of resources for webOS.

3. Awesome Qgis

Data Sources / Field and Mobile

  • Geoscience Data Portals (⭐2) - Connection files for the WMS and WFS services of government geological surveys, loaded through the Data Source Manager.

4. Awesome Jmeter

Tutorials

  • Performance Testing with JMeter - A step-by-step guide to designing and running load tests with Apache JMeter.

5. Awesome Data Engineering

Data Ingestion

  • adbcBridge (⭐2) - Driver for ADBC, Apache Arrow's database connectivity API, that sits on top of any ODBC driver, so databases with no native Arrow driver return columnar Arrow record batches and take bulk ingest.
  • Renart (⭐96) - Local-first IDE for authoring and running SQL and Python data pipelines stored in Git.
  • OLake (⭐1.6k) - Open-source replication of Postgres, MySQL, MongoDB, Oracle, SQL Server, DB2, Kafka and S3 into Apache Iceberg, with CDC and table maintenance. Written in Go.
  • Firecrawl (⭐200k) - Open-source web data API that scrapes, crawls, maps, and searches the web and returns Markdown or structured JSON for data pipelines and LLM ingestion.

Serialization format

  • SequenceFile - A flat file consisting of binary key/value pairs. It is extensively used in MapReduce as input/output formats.

Stream Processing

  • Spring Cloud Dataflow - Streaming and tasks execution between Spring Boot apps.

Charts and Dashboards

  • SmoothieCharts (⭐2.3k) - A JavaScript Charting Library for Streaming Data.
  • Streamlit - An open-source Python framework for building interactive data apps and dashboards with minimal code. Connects to any data source and supports real-time updates, caching, and one-click deployment.
  • GeoSQL (⭐684) - Claude/Codex skill for cost-safe geospatial SQL on BigQuery and Snowflake.

Workflow

  • Cascading - Java based application development platform.
  • Dataform (⭐1k) - An open-source framework and web based IDE to manage datasets and their dependencies. SQLX extends your existing SQL warehouse dialect to add features that support dependency management, testing, documentation and more.
  • Ciaren (⭐37) - A local-first visual ETL and ML workflow builder with per-step previews, cron scheduling, and export to pandas or Polars code.

Datasets / Data Dumps

  • OpenChainBench - Live dataset of crypto infrastructure benchmarks (RPC latency, oracle deviation, bridge fees, L1 finality, perp DEX metrics). Open methodology, CC BY 4.0, Zenodo DOI 10.5281/zenodo.20800312. Source (⭐9).

Profiling / Data Profiler

  • dataprof (⭐33) - Data profiling and quality gates for CSV, JSON, Parquet, DataFrames and Arrow tables, with a Rust core and a Python API.
  • Dex (⭐116) - Agent-native warehouse profiling, join verification, and schema-drift detection with dbt transformation workflows.

Testing / Data Profiler

  • DataOps TestGen (⭐81) - Open-source data quality tool that profiles tables, generates validation tests from the profiling results, and monitors freshness, volume, and schema from a web UI.

Community / Conferences

  • Data Council - The first technical conference that bridges the gap between data scientists, data engineers and data analysts.

6. Awesome Bigdata

SQL-like processing

  • Timeplus Proton (⭐2.3k) - streaming SQL engine in a single C++ binary, powered by ClickHouse, for streaming ETL, windowed aggregations, joins and materialized views over Kafka and other sources.
  • Opteryx - hosted single-node SQL engine that queries Parquet and JSONL files where they live (GCS, S3, HTTP), with Iceberg and PostgreSQL sources.

Distributed Tracing Platform

  • Zipkin - Zipkin is a distributed tracing system. It helps gather timing data needed to troubleshoot latency problems in service architectures. Features include both the collection and lookup of this data.

Interesting Readings

  • WebSocket fan-out with Redis pub/sub - Practical guide to sharing one upstream data stream across services, with subscription budgets, last-value caching and reconnect handling.

7. Awesome Design Systems

Design systems of some "known" companies

  • Firefox Acorn Design System - Launch recognizable, enjoyable Firefox products and features faster.
  • Google Material Design - Create intuitive and beautiful products with Material Design.

Design systems articles

  • Design systems and AI: Why MCP servers are the unlock

More resources

  • Design system checklist - Build better design systems. An open-source checklist to help you plan, build and grow your design system.
  • Design.system - Resources for the design systems community.

Design tools

  • Penpot - The first Open Source design and prototyping platform meant for cross-domain teams.

Accessibility (a11y)

  • The A11Y Project - A community-driven effort to make web accessibility easier. See resources section.

Design tokens

  • Design Tokens Format Module 2025.10 - First stable version of the Design Tokens Community Group specification, with format, color and resolver modules.

Plugins

  • Tokens Studio - Manage design tokens in Figma and keep them in sync with your code repository.

Tools

  • Style Dictionary (⭐4.9k) - A Style Dictionary uses design tokens to define styles once and use those styles on any platform or language.
  • Terrazzo - Generate code for web, mobile and native apps from design tokens JSON in the Design Tokens Community Group format.

Develop isolated components / Storybook addons

  • Accessibility - Test component compliance with web accessibility standards.
  • Actions - Get UI feedback when an action is performed on an interactive element.
  • Backgrounds - Switch backgrounds to view components in different settings.
  • Docs - Document component usage and properties in Markdown.
  • Links - Link stories together to build demos and prototypes with your UI components.
  • Source - View a story's source code to see how it works and paste into your app.
  • Viewport - Build responsive components by adjusting Storybook's viewport size and orientation.
  • Vitest - Run every story as a Vitest test, with interaction, accessibility and visual checks.

Component patterns / Storybook addons

  • ARIA Authoring Practices Guide patterns - Reference patterns from the W3C for building accessible components, with keyboard interaction and working examples.
  • Open UI - W3C Community Group that researches how design systems name and build components, and proposes new native HTML controls.
  • The Component Gallery - Up-to-date repository of interface components based on examples from real design systems.

Headless component libraries / Storybook addons

  • Ark UI - Unstyled, accessible components for your design system that work in React, Vue, Solid and Svelte.
  • Base UI - Unstyled components for building accessible design systems, from the creators of Radix, Floating UI and Material UI.
  • Radix Primitives - Open-source component library for building high-quality, accessible design systems and web apps.
  • React Aria - Accessible components and hooks with behavior, internationalization and no imposed styles, by Adobe.
  • shadcn/ui - Composable, accessible components you copy into your codebase and own, distributed through a registry.

Pattern libraries articles / Storybook addons

  • Design systems workflow in Storybook
  • How packaging makes it dead simple to share UI components

AI and design systems / Storybook addons

  • DESIGN.md (⭐29k) - Format specification for describing a visual identity and design system to coding agents.
  • Figma Code Connect (⭐1.6k) - Connects design system components in code with their counterparts in Figma, so developers and agents get real snippets.
  • Figma Console MCP (⭐3.3k) - MCP server that connects AI assistants to Figma for design system extraction, creation and debugging.
  • Figma MCP server - Official server that gives AI agents the design context of your Figma files to generate code, and lets them write back to the canvas.
  • Storybook MCP addon - Helps agents write and test stories for your UI components.

Unit & Regression test / Storybook addons

  • Chromatic - Visual testing for React, Angular and Vue. Chromatic ensures consistency in UI components, down to the pixel. Every commit is automatically tested for visual changes in the cloud.

Books / Storybook addons

  • Building Design Systems - Unify user experiences through a shared design language by Sarrah Vesselov and Taurie Davis.
  • Frontend Architecture for Design Systems - A modern blueprint for scalable and sustainable websites by Micah Godbolt.

Talks / Storybook addons

  • Design Processes & Systems in Craft - Design shouldn't be a siloed practice, but a collaborative effort rooted in process. How do we get there? In this session, we'll look at how we can reframe our design approach to be more human-centric and systems-minded by Courtney Bradford.

8. Awesome Cli Apps in a Csv

Text processing

  • TeXicode (⭐66) - TeX to Unicode, a Unicode TeX renderer that renders TeX into Unicode by rendering the TeX.

Dotfile managers

  • dudu (⭐6) - Back up your whole dev setup in one command and restore it on a new machine in another: packages, runtimes, dotfiles and terminal, on macOS, Linux and Windows.

Connection managers

  • bayesian-ssh (⭐19) - SSH session manager for the terminal and the desktop: fuzzy, usage-ranked search, bastions, Kerberos, file transfer, and bssh Teams for end-to-end encrypted sharing.

AI / LLM integration

  • shell_sage (⭐407) - AI-powered command-line assistant that integrates seamlessly with your terminal workflow through tmux. It provides contextual help for shell operations, making it easier to navigate complex command-line tasks, debug scripts, and manage your system.

Weather

  • rustormy (⭐91) - Minimal and neofetch-like weather CLI with multiple data providers support, ASCI-icons, ANSI colors, localization and various output modes.

9. Awesome Langchain

Tools / Low-code

  • RocketRide (⭐20k): Open-source AI meta-harness with a C++ runtime and a visual canvas for building agents and RAG pipelines, with LangChain agent and text-splitter nodes

Tools / Services

  • LangChain Agent Skills (⭐106): Agent skills that teach AI coding assistants (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) to build, test and deploy LangChain, LangGraph, LangSmith and Deep Agents projects

10. Awesome Cakephp

Plugins / Miscellaneous

  • Interact plugin (⭐3) - Interactive pages using native CakePHP templates and Alpine.js.

11. Awesome Healthcare

Contents / Imaging

  • Dicoogle (⭐536) - Dicoogle is an extensible, platform-independent and open-source PACS

12. Awesome Keycloak

Tools

  • kcac: Effective Access Export for Access Reviews (⭐0)

13. Awesome Raspberry Pi

Tools

  • Gearotons M17 (⭐18) - Integrated servomotor with the motor, driver, motion controller and encoder in one NEMA 17 body, driven from a Pi with a Python library, several motors on one RS-485 bus.

Projects

  • led-ticker (⭐2) - Raspberry Pi toolkit for driving large RGB LED matrix signs via a TOML config, with scrolling news, weather, crypto, sports and calendar feeds, animated transitions, and a plugin system.
  • Murmur (⭐18) - Turns your phone into a BLE-connected shell and AI agent for a headless Raspberry Pi, no network required on the Pi and bring your own LLM key.
  • RelayTV (⭐99) - Turns a Raspberry Pi connected to a TV over HDMI into a local media endpoint with V4L2/HEVC hardware decoding, HDMI-CEC control, a mobile remote for Plex, Jellyfin, Emby and IPTV, and Home Assistant integration. Supports Raspberry Pi 4 and 5.

14. Awesome Dataviz

JavaScript tools / Charting libraries

  • Britecharts (⭐3.7k) - Accessible D3-based charts for JavaScript and React, with keyboard navigation, dark mode and TypeScript support.

JavaScript tools / Financial charts

  • Lightweight Charts React Components (⭐140) - Declarative React components for financial charts built on TradingView Lightweight Charts.

JavaScript tools / Misc

  • AVA (⭐1.6k) - TypeScript visual analytics framework for AI agents, with file and database queries, reusable business definitions and interactive charts.

Other tools / Text visualization

  • evident-charts (⭐62) - Agent skill that makes explanatory charts and checks them for misleading axes, overlapping labels, and color problems.
  • RustGIS (⭐2.6k) - Fast, free and open-source GIS for mapping, analyzing and sharing geospatial data, native and in the browser.

15. Awesome Ai in Finance

Agents

  • FastTrade AI (⭐1) - Signal-only LLM market research workspace with deterministic risk checks, a budgeted batch API, and reproducible checksummed backtests. Never places orders.
  • oracle3 (⭐569) - Prediction-market trading engine and MCP server for Kalshi, Polymarket, and Solana, with fee-aware no-arbitrage checks across related contracts and live or paper execution.
  • DXAP - Agentic trading harness on Hyperliquid by DX Research Group: write a strategy in plain language, an AI agent trades your own account inside limits a policy engine enforces, and every decision is logged.
  • seduma-trade-agent-demo (⭐0) - Practice-only loop that runs LLM trading-agent decisions through confirm-gated simulated fills.
  • LLM_trader (⭐141) - An LLM trading agent that reads a chart rendered from every closed candle, retrieves its own closed trades as memory, and publishes every prompt, decision and loss; paper trading with a ledger the repo can reproduce.
  • AlphaFinch (⭐2) - AlphaEvolve-style agent that invents and evolves trading strategies as code, then grades them on sealed holdouts and a pre-registered multi-market exam; no brokerage connection.
  • multi-agent-investment (⭐0) - Multi-agent equity research with three reasoning modes and deterministic signal fusion; decisions are reproducible from a pure-function core, with an offline demo that needs no API keys.
  • FriesTrader (⭐307) - Claude Code template for automated live orders through Robinhood Agentic Trading MCP, with rule-based position sizing and trade limits. Requires an eligible Robinhood Agentic Trading account.

Skills

  • Krexa (⭐119) - Agent skill and remote MCP server for turning a trading idea, post or video into fixed rules, backtesting and paper-trading them free, and requesting a user-approved live trading agent on Binance, Coinbase, Kraken, OKX, Bybit, MEXC, Hyperliquid, Polymarket and Solana DEXs.
  • SmartMoney-Cub (⭐26) - Read-only trading journal and review harness for agents: freezes point-in-time evidence packs, replays them deterministically, and grades rule candidates on a frozen 240-case finance benchmark. MIT.

Market Data

  • itulo/eu-nordic-open-data-mcp (⭐0) - Open-source MCP server for official EU open data: ECB FX rates, policy rates and HICP inflation, EU consolidated sanctions screening, VIES VAT validation, and GLEIF LEI ownership chains. No API key for these tools; same tools also available as pay-per-use Apify actors.

Research & Analysis

  • firecrawl/firecrawl-mcp-server (⭐7.8k) - Official Firecrawl MCP server for finance research agents: web search, scrape, and crawl, plus Alexandria providers for SEC EDGAR filings and FRED macro series. Alexandria requires an API key.
  • Kernel-Hunter/kandle (⭐9) - Open-source browser charting app with an MCP server: agents read the chart, draw levels, add indicators and alerts, and run strategy backtests on crypto, stocks and forex.
  • signal8ai/signal8-mcp (⭐1) - Official Signal8 MCP server: small-cap dilution (warrants, ATMs, shelf registrations, convertibles, cash runway) with each figure cited to its SEC filing, plus insider and congressional trades, halts and reverse splits. Requires a Signal8 Pro API key.

  • 🆓 pixelfx.io - Free animated pixel art effects for games, with browser previews, recoloring, and transparent PNG sprite sheet and animation JSON downloads; MIT-licensed library assets.

Graphics / Spritesheet Tools

  • 💰 Border Kit for Tiled - Python CLI to extrude PNG tilesets and update external TSX files while preserving tile IDs, animations and collision objects.

Graphics / Texture Tools

  • 🆓 Normal Map Bench - Generate tangent-space normal maps for game textures from height images in the browser, with a live lighting preview and OpenGL or DirectX PNG export.

Graphics / Animation

  • 💰 Animate4Me - Turns a text prompt or an image into a Spine 4.2 animation with bones and weighted meshes for 2D game symbols, objects and characters; previews in the browser and exports skeleton.json, atlas and PNG pages.
  • 💸 VfxSmith - AI pixel art VFX generator for games with chat refinement, editable effect components, and sprite sheet, JSON, GIF, PNG sequence and Godot 4 exports; free library and editing, paid AI generation after initial credits.

Graphics / Vector/Image Editor

  • 💸 klad - Drawing and animation app for 2D game art that people and coding agents edit together: every stroke and fill stays editable data, pixel layers, tilesets with Godot TileSet export, Aseprite in and out, sprite sheet and GIF export, and MIT agent skills that teach any agent to paint and judge drawing and pixel art. Free for personal use and small companies. Source (⭐161)
  • 🆓 PixelArtHive Sprite Upscaler - Resize sprites for 2D games at whole-number scales without blur. Runs in the browser without uploading the sprite.

AI / Voxel Editors

  • 🎉 AI Art Engine (⭐268) - Node-based AI game asset studio for generating and refining sprites, Spine 2D/DragonBones/Live2D rigs, 3D models, PBR materials, shaders and SFX, with MCP agent control and Unity/Godot/Cocos export.
  • 💰 Buildaloo - AI game maker for kids 5–12: a kid says a game idea out loud and plays the game in the browser. Parent account, no ads, no stranger chat.
  • 💸 PlayDrop - Make a browser game by describing it, or publish one your AI app made, and share it with a link.

Board Games / Voxel Editors

  • 💸 Game Piece Studio - Browser-based designer for board game cards, boards, tiles and tokens that binds layouts to spreadsheet data and exports print-ready PDF/PNG.
  • 🆓 RandomGeneratr NPC Generator - Generate NPC cards with names, roles, motives, flaws, secrets, factions and story hooks for tabletop RPG preparation.

Blogs and Portals / Voxel Editors

  • Gamealia - Free HTML5 web games portal in 32 languages; developers publish their web games (HTML5, Unity WebGL, Godot) with no exclusivity and an ad revenue share (ads are not live yet).

63. Awesome Mac

Reading and Writing Tools / Office

  • Keynote - Build stunning presentations.
  • Numbers - Create impressive spreadsheets.
  • Pages - Documents that stand apart.

Reading and Writing Tools / Markdown Tools

  • Downright - Native, open-source Markdown reader and editor for ordinary files, with Quick Look previews, Finder thumbnails, and live reload when another app or agent changes the file.

Reading and Writing Tools / Note-taking

  • Noteriv - Open-source Markdown note-taking app with wiki-links, graph view, plugins, Git/WebDAV sync and a built-in MCP server for AI assistants.

Reading and Writing Tools / Writing

  • Rewrite - Rewrite text, fix grammar, and edit Word, LaTeX and PDF files.

Reading and Writing Tools / Others

  • HistCite Mac (⭐2) - Open-source bibliometric analysis and citation network visualization for Web of Science exports.

Developer Tools / Developer Utilities

  • arowser (⭐0) - Agent-programmable borderless web windows for macOS, driven by a CLI designed for coding agents.
  • ServerHat (⭐1) - Free menu-bar app that runs your local dev servers. Claude Code and Codex can start, stop and read logs through its MCP server and local API, with your approval.

Developer Tools / Frameworks For Hybrid Applications

  • MyPack - Turn websites into desktop apps for macOS, Windows, and Linux.

Terminal Apps / Databases

  • Cue - IDE-style autocomplete for commands, options, Git branches, and files in zsh on Apple Terminal and VS Code’s integrated terminal.
  • Cyberdog - SSH and SFTP client with a built-in terminal, a server health dashboard and FTP, S3 and WebDAV support.

Design and Product / Screenshot Tools

  • Lumela (⭐13) - Cross-platform screenshot tool that blurs emails, card numbers, IPs and API keys with on-device OCR, then beautifies the shot.
  • WellSnap - Open-source screenshot tool for macOS and Windows with arrows, numbered callouts, and a blur that never uses the hidden pixels.

Design and Product / Screen Recording

  • Back to Bug (⭐0) - Menu bar replay recorder that saves recent screen activity as video for bug reports.
  • Native Screen - Open-source screen recorder and editor with a multi-track timeline, auto-zoom, and on-device captions.

Design and Product / Other Tools

  • Louppe - Photo and video viewer and sorter for browsing JPEG, RAW, and video folders, choosing keepers with the keyboard, and copying them without a library import.

AI Tools / Other Tools

  • Airbag (⭐3) - Open-source menu bar app that snapshots a project before each shell command an AI coding agent runs that can change files, so deleted files and a wiped .env can be restored in one click.
  • AppleAi (⭐144) - Access multiple AI assistants from your menu bar with one shortcut.
  • BaseHalf - Open-source desktop app that opens a folder as a canvas of notes, PDFs and media, with AI agents like Claude Code or Codex working on the same files beside it.
  • o8 - Open-source desktop app that reviews coding agents' work, sends it back until it passes, and merges it.
  • SummonOS - Menu bar app and CLI that gives coding agents live Mac context over MCP and snapshots supported settings changes so they can be undone.
  • TurboFieldfare (⭐7.4k) - Native ChatGPT-like Mac app running Google’s Gemma AI (26B-A4B MoE) privately on your device, even on low-end 8 GB M-series Macs.
  • kwant - Self-hosted team of AI bots in one Rust binary, with spaces, local models, handoffs and approvals.
  • MoMo Agent (⭐15) - Open-source, self-hosted 24/7 personal agent for Apple Watch, iPhone, and Mac with on-device CoreML ASR, embedded Tailscale, and an Obsidian-style Markdown memory vault.
  • Quarters - Open-source workspace for running terminal coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI and Aider across many projects at once, with one-click project switching, dev-server launching and remote access from your phone.

Utilities / Menu Bar Tools

  • Usagebar - Free native macOS menu bar app that shows Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Kimi Code, z.ai and DeepSeek usage limits, plus when they reset.
  • Claude Accounts (⭐3) - Switches the Claude desktop app between your accounts with one click, without losing sessions.
  • Lafz Prompter - Teleprompter that sits under the MacBook notch, can hide from screen sharing, scrolls as you speak, and shows Urdu in Nastaliq.
  • Polka - Turns the MacBook notch into a control center for VPN connections, tab groups from any browser, now playing, calendar, an on-device translator and clipboard history.
  • Daily Wallpaper - Menu bar app that sets the Bing photo of the day as your desktop and lock screen wallpaper.
  • LogoLight - Menu bar app that turns off, dims, or animates the illuminated Apple logo on the MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR Display.
  • Mask This (⭐23) - Menu bar app that masks sensitive information in the clipboard.
  • Menew - All-in-one menu bar app with a command palette, clipboard history, window snapping, screenshots, a system monitor, meeting minutes and Claude Code/Codex usage limits, using on-device AI.
  • NØTH (⭐1) - Turns the MacBook notch into live activities and a command center for music, files, clipboard, calendar, notes and tools.
  • Sheer (⭐0) - Brings the macOS 26-style transparent menu bar to macOS 15, letting the wallpaper show through with a faint legibility gradient.
  • TocaPad (⭐1) - Slide your trackpad's edges to change volume and brightness, and double-tap a corner to run a shortcut.
  • twistel (⭐4) - Menu bar file converter: drag files, hold a key and drop them on a ring menu to convert images, audio, video and documents, compress, OCR, redact or sign PDFs, fully offline.

Communication / Collaboration and Team Tools

  • Textual (⭐1.9k) - Internet Relay Chat (IRC) client.
  • WhatsApp Desktop - Available in the Mac App Store, Whatsapp for Desktop.

Audio and Video Tools / File Sharing

  • LazyTune (⭐2) - Lightweight menu bar per-app audio mixer and universal media key controller for web browsers and desktop players.
  • Nimbus (⭐3) - Native SoundCloud client with gapless playback, a drag-and-drop queue, Chromecast and a full-screen vinyl player.
  • Roughcut (⭐0) - Turns a folder of talking-head footage into a rough cut in Final Cut Pro, with on-device Whisper transcription and cuts chosen by a local or cloud AI model.
  • YouTube Music (⭐34k) - Desktop player for YouTube Music with plugin support.

Audio and Video Tools / Audio Record and Process

  • VoiceStudio - Real-time broadcast voice rack in Swift and CoreAudio with subtle pitch depth, sub-harmonic warmth, 6-band EQ, de-esser, and compressor for Discord, Zoom, Teams, and OBS.

Voice-to-Text / Audio Record and Process

  • Earshot (⭐16) - Menu bar app that transcribes the audio of any app you pick, fully on-device, with speaker names in Microsoft Teams.
  • Lowspeak (⭐6) - Native, ultrafast AI dictation written in Rust: hold fn to talk into any app in 35 languages, free online with your own Groq key or offline with Whisper and Parakeet.

Browsers / Audio Record and Process

  • Brk (⭐2) - Native Swift and AppKit rebuild of Arc on Chromium, with a Raycast-style command bar and AI that runs on your own Claude Code or Codex plan and local models.
  • Ora (⭐2.2k) - Open-source browser with spaces, tab management, and a vertical sidebar.

Finance / Audio Record and Process

  • MRRDock (⭐8) - Menu bar app that adds up your MRR from Stripe, RevenueCat, Paddle, Lemon Squeezy, Polar, Dodo Payments and Gumroad into one total. Multi-currency, keys stay in the Keychain, no account.

Security Tools / Audio Record and Process

  • AI Access Auditor - See and revoke what AI coding agents like Claude Code, Codex and Cursor can access on your Mac.
  • Mana Security (⭐28) - vulnerability management app for individuals.
  • Vigie (⭐0) - Open-source blue team tool that runs Sigma detection rules on the macOS unified log, Windows event logs and Linux auth.log, live or on collected files, and writes a report mapped to MITRE ATT&CK.

Proxy and VPN Tools / Audio Record and Process

  • LockPlus (⭐15) - WireGuard and OpenVPN client with a kill switch that macOS itself enforces.
  • Vafa (⭐1) - Open-source VPN kill switch that freezes chosen apps and blocks their network until a VPN with an allowed exit country is up.

Utilities / Clipboard Tools

  • Cue - Clipboard that reads the focused field and pastes the part of your clip that fits, such as an email address or a phone number.

Utilities / Cleanup and Uninstall

  • Cleaner - Open-source cleaner that shows every item before removal, keeps its rules in one public file, and holds what you remove in a 7-day quarantine you can restore from.
  • DiskPilot - Free, open-source storage analyzer for developers that explains each folder (Docker, node_modules, Xcode DerivedData, AI tool caches), marks what is safe to delete and moves everything to the Trash first.
  • MacClean (⭐2) - Free local Mac disk cleaner that lets you review WeChat media, System Data, and Xcode or AI caches before deleting.
  • MacSweep (⭐2) - Free, open-source Mac cleaner written in Rust (~7 MB) for junk cleanup, large files, app uninstalling with leftovers and orphaned launch agents, with tests ensuring browser profiles, Mail and app data are never deleted.
  • Purge (⭐2k) - Open-source cache cleaner that moves files to the Trash instead of deleting them, using a fixed allowlist and no telemetry.

Utilities / General Tools

  • LocalSR - Open-source app for upscaling, denoising and restoring photos and videos with local AI models.
  • Pake - Turn any website into a lightweight desktop app with its own icon, window and Dock entry.
  • Yado - Native Mac app for managing an iPhone: clear duplicate photos, large videos and unused apps, arrange the Home Screen, move files and keep backups on the Mac.

Utilities / Productivity

  • Browserdoor (⭐5) - Open-source link picker that asks which browser, browser profile, or Zen space should open each link.
  • Keylane (⭐3) - Source-available keyboard launcher for macOS 26+ with app and file search, clipboard history, and system actions.
  • LinkUnbound - Open-source browser picker that asks which browser or browser profile should open each link, with rules by site or by the app the link came from.
  • MagicInput - Share one keyboard and mouse between a Mac and a Windows PC by moving the pointer past the screen edge, with clipboard sync and file transfer.
  • Perplexity - Search and discovery with AI.
  • SwiftBiu - Text productivity tool with a customizable action bar and AI extensions.
  • Takeline (⭐1) - Fork of Textream that follows your voice in French and English entirely on the Mac, with retake detection and voice commands.
  • Trace (⭐8) - Automatic time tracker that records apps, windows, files, and web pages, with all data kept on your Mac.
  • Volant - Private, open-source launcher for apps, files, calculations, notes, clipboard history and coding agents.

Utilities / Window Management

  • Show Bar - Windows-style Command-Tab window switcher with live thumbnails, Dock hover window previews, window snapping, clipboard history, and a screenshot shelf.

Utilities / Finder Tools

  • PC Mode (⭐2) - Free app that brings Windows habits to your Mac: delete from Finder with the Delete key, cut and move files with ⌘X and ⌘V, and switch individual windows with ⌘Tab.

Utilities / Quality of Life Improvements

  • Dimmerly - Open-source menu bar app for per-display brightness, warmth, and contrast, with presets, schedules, and DDC/CI monitor control.

Utilities / System Related Tools

  • Fan Curve (⭐0) - Open-source fan curve controller for Apple Silicon Macs that sets fan speed from CPU temperature.
  • FixStat (⭐8) - Menu bar monitor and diagnostics for Mac repair: per-model sensor names, battery cell data, SSD SMART including USB drives, panic history and guided hardware tests.
  • Kombucha (⭐9) - Menu bar battery charge limiter that stops charging at a chosen level to extend battery lifespan.
  • LD Manager - Open-source launchd manager that shows every LaunchAgent and LaunchDaemon, explains why a job isn't running, and edits plists losslessly with diffs and backups.

Gaming Software / System Related Tools

  • Soju - Installs the official Windows Battle.net, Steam, Epic, GOG, EA app, Rockstar and Ubisoft Connect clients on Apple Silicon through Wine and Apple's GPTK, with a native library of all your games.

64. Awesome Rust

Applications

  • alexsergivan/kwant (⭐519) - Self-hosted team of AI bots in one binary, with spaces, handoffs, approvals and routines

Applications / Database

  • ModernRelay/omnigraph (⭐1.9k) - Typed property graph database that stores graphs on object storage (S3-compatible or local disk) in the Lance format, with Git-style branches and merges, schemas enforced on every write, and graph traversal, vector search and full-text search in one query.

Applications / Graphics

  • TobiasGrothmann/plottery (⭐2) [plottery_lib] - Generative art engine for pen plotters, with a desktop editor to tweak parameters live.

Applications / MLOps

  • logicplanes/kaeso (⭐6) [kaeso-kpp] - Self-hosted AI gateway with OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible APIs, SSO, budgets and request logs

Applications / Observability

  • uptimepage/uptimepage (⭐55) - Uptime monitoring with public status pages and automatic incidents, with a REST API and a Terraform provider.

Applications / Productivity

  • ChrisVip001/joyczl-agent (⭐112) - Local-first personal agent: Rust owns the agent loop, memory and tools, and stores one append-only ledger row per turn, so every memory is inspectable and the FTS5 index can be rebuilt from the ledger. TypeScript dashboard, Python SDK.
  • glimpse-hq/Glimpse (⭐62) - Local voice dictation and meeting transcription for macOS and Windows, built with Tauri. Speech recognition and speaker labels run on your computer.
  • madebyzan/knovum (⭐63) - Local-first desktop 2D spatial AI knowledge workspace built with Tauri 2, Rust, and Vue 3, featuring infinite canvas, embedded LanceDB vector search, and on-device Whisper transcription.

Applications / Security tools

  • nestho/impacket-rs (⭐90) - Memory-safe pure-Rust implementation of enterprise network protocols (SMB, MSRPC, Kerberos, LDAP, NTLM) and Active Directory auditing tools.
  • offseq/threat-finder (⭐66) [threat-finder] - Runtime vulnerability scanner that finds CVEs in the services actually running on a host and ranks them by network exposure

Applications / System tools

  • DuskXi/SpaceKnife (⭐57) - Cross-platform disk usage analyzer with live treemap and flame graph views, NTFS MFT quick scan, scan load limits and snapshot comparison, built with Tauri
  • Ray-lea/Argus (⭐1.4k) - A native Windows task manager built with GPUI Kit, with real-time CPU, memory, disk, network and GPU monitoring, process and service management, file-lock inspection, and resource usage history.

Applications / Text editors

  • thejacedev/Noteriv (⭐112) - A Markdown note-taking app with wiki-links, a graph view, plugins and Git sync, built with Tauri 2.

Applications / Video

  • yuxino/mimi (⭐851) - Live bilingual subtitle overlay for videos and streams, built with Rust and Tauri.

Applications / Workflow Automation

  • julianosig/easi.run (⭐83) - Self-hosted Chrome for AI agents via MCP/REST, with live viewing and human takeover. AGPL-3.0-only.

Development tools / Workflow Automation

  • gvcgo/version-manager (⭐1.3k) - A cross-platform SDK version manager with project-level version pinning and session isolation.

Development tools / Embedded

  • Internationalization
    • AlixANNERAUD/embedded_i18n (⭐1) [embedded-i18n] - Compile-time i18n for no_std firmware: translations from JSON, YAML, TOML, gettext PO/MO or Fluent files compiled into &'static str literals in flash, with plurals, fallbacks and no allocator.

Libraries / Data processing

  • sshaplygin/ytsaurus-rs (⭐5) [ytsaurus-yson] - Rust clients for YTsaurus: HTTP API v4 and RPC proxy (dynamic tables through one interface), YSON and Skiff codecs, and a runtime for MapReduce workers

Libraries / Geospatial

  • open-geocode-rs/open-geocode (⭐58) [open-geocode] - Fast, lightweight, self-hosted geocoding in pure Rust.

Libraries / GUI

  • IUP
    • Kiss-ui (⭐344) - A simple UI framework built on IUP

Libraries / Parsing

  • AlixANNERAUD/nanoexpr (⭐2) [nanoexpr] - Fast no_std math expression parser and evaluator with zero heap allocation: variables, functions, f32/f64/integers or exact decimals, for microcontrollers, WebAssembly and C.

65. Awesome Machine Learning

Python / General-Purpose Machine Learning

  • eigenkit (⭐25) - Quantum machine learning in Python: hybrid quantum neural networks as PyTorch modules and quantum kernel models (QSVC/QSVR) with a scikit-learn API, run on PennyLane, Qiskit, CUDA-Q and other simulators or on IBM, IQM and Amazon Braket QPUs.

66. Awesome Readme

Examples

  • shivrajsinhzala/transit-timetables (⭐0) - Live production demo link. Clear problem statement, step-by-step pipeline commands, hosting architecture details, indexing strategy, and open data attribution.
